$Comment: Kill XP for Christmas's creatures, on a server running MMO Skill Tree. Only that mod reads this folder,
so without it the file is never loaded.
A pattern is matched as a substring of the creature's role id and the longest match wins, so each row
names one role by its whole id and reaches only that role, ahead of the shorter patterns MMO Skill Tree
ships. Without these rows a Present Thief would fall to the plain fallback (its id never says Trork),
the Yeti would pay as the game's wild Yeti, and the Yeti's wolves would tie between Yeti and Wolf. The
Yeti's wolves' row is longer than the Yeti's, whose id theirs begins with.
The value is the XP a kill is worth before any boost, at each creature's own worth: a Present Thief is a
Trork and pays a Trork's, the Yeti is a boss and pays a boss's (his fight's Claims pay Defense XP on top),
and his White Wolves keep the game's white wolf's strength and pay a wolf's.
Name: Mmo_Christmas_Creatures
